method: Isolated before/after source snapshots with identical non-task code and cached public responses. Sample harness pages/paragraphs/sentences, filtered to sentences containing " to ", LCG shuffle seed 1104, first 30.

sample_summary.review: Both changed sample outputs improve the construction; no observed regressions. Many pre-existing lexical and clause errors remain.

remaining_problems: need selects Russian нуждаться and keeps its inappropriate government even though its English infinitive is parsed correctly.
go to work is a prepositional phrase but its Russian goal/preposition still needs work.
listen to music retains an inappropriate Russian preposition.
Capitalized Sellers remains unresolved; join and scam translations and coordinated purpose punctuation remain imperfect.
Absence from the public catenative inventory is a fallback negative, not a proof that all senses reject infinitives.
